facts.fact: Wavemaker's pipeline includes an AI storyboard with 21 presets to choose a look.
facts.quote: then an AI storyboard (with 21 presets to pick a look)

facts.fact: According to Wavemaker, most of its product demo videos come back in two to five minutes.
facts.quote: Most videos come back in two to five minutes.

facts.fact: The article says a strong product demo can deliver problem, features, and outcome within 30 to 60 seconds.
facts.quote: You can hit all three of these in 30 to 60 seconds.

facts.fact: The article recommends a feature spotlight clip of 20 to 30 seconds focused on one new feature.
facts.quote: a sharp 20 to 30 second clip on one new feature

facts.fact: The article recommends a demo show only the two or three features that carry the most weight for the promised outcome.
facts.quote: Pick the two or three features that carry the most weight for the outcome you're promising

facts.fact: In the recommended demo script arc, the problem hook runs from 0 to 8 seconds.
facts.quote: Hook with the problem (0 to 8 seconds).

facts.fact: In the recommended demo script arc, introducing the product as the fix runs from 8 to 15 seconds.
facts.quote: Introduce the product as the fix (8 to 15 seconds).

facts.fact: In the recommended demo script arc, showing key features in action runs from 15 to 45 seconds.
facts.quote: Show the key features in action (15 to 45 seconds).

facts.fact: In the recommended demo script arc, the outcome and call to action run from 45 to 60 seconds.
facts.quote: Land the outcome and call to action (45 to 60 seconds).

facts.fact: The article states that vertical (9:16) framing matches where app demo videos live, such as TikTok, Reels, and app store previews.
facts.quote: Vertical (9:16) framing matches where these videos live

facts.fact: Adwave can run a finished video as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks, starting from $50, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: Adwave can run it as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks, starting from $50, alongside Google, YouTube, Meta, and Reddit.

facts.fact: Wavemaker exports video in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 aspect ratios.
facts.quote: Wavemaker exports in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 so you're covered everywhere.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free $0 plan includes 75 credits and 480p export with a watermark.
facts.quote: You can make your first one free on the $0 plan, which includes 75 credits (enough for a first video), 480p export with a watermark.

facts.fact: Wavemaker paid plans start at $29 per month, offering up to 1080p resolution with no watermark.
facts.quote: Paid plans start at $29/mo for higher resolution up to 1080p and no watermark, and go up to 4K on higher tiers.

facts.fact: A roughly 30-second video costs about 75 credits in Wavemaker, and refining a draft costs 15 credits.
facts.quote: A roughly 30-second video runs about 75 credits, and refining a draft costs only 15.

facts.fact: Wavemaker refining a draft costs 15 credits.
For most product demo uses, 30 to 60 seconds is the suggested length, per the article.
facts.quote: For most uses, 30 to 60 seconds hits the sweet spot

facts.fact: Longer product walkthroughs of two to three minutes are suggested for complex software when the viewer has already opted in.
facts.quote: Longer, more detailed walkthroughs (two to three minutes) work for complex software when the viewer has already opted in

facts.fact: The article advises picking the best three features for a product demo rather than showing everything.
